title: Evalvacija napredka generativne umetne inteligence pri snovanju nalog iz visje matematike: Primerjalna studija

live_model.evidence: Table 1 (Orodja in verzije): "Copilot | GPT-4 Turbo (April 2025) | GPT-4o (Januar 2026) | Integracija novejsega OpenAI modela."

prompt.location: Sec 2.2 (Testne naloge): "Vsem orodjem smo podali identicen poziv (prompt): 'Rad bi nekaj netrivialnih nalog za visjo matematiko...'"
prompt.note: Single verbatim prompt (Slovenian) requesting 5 non-trivial higher-math tasks with solutions, sent once per tool (single-shot).

claim.metric: none numeric (Table 2 reports only categorical Da/Ne (yes/no) and qualitative Uspesno/Neuspesno (success/failure) outcomes per tool per task)
claim.location: Table 2 (Primerjava izpolnjevanja metodoloskih kriterijev), row 'Copilot' under 'Determinanta': 'Neuspesno (halucinacija)' for the April-2025 GPT-4-Turbo-backed phase

data.source: 5 author-authored higher-mathematics tasks (matrix inverse, determinant, plane intersection, parallelepiped volume, local extrema); not released

notes: Copilot is a consumer web/chat product (webui, not API); GPT-4 Turbo was its backend only in the April-2025 phase of this two-timepoint comparison (superseded by GPT-4o by January 2026). Results are reported as a 5-task qualitative pass/fail table, not a numeric score.
